description: Your own request usage: your plan and, for the month, the minute and the hour, the request limit and what is used of it. `plan` is free, starter, requests, requests_plus or custom, or null when no plan limit covers your account. `month` {limit, used, remaining, resets_at (the first day of next month, 00:00 UTC)}, all null when no monthly limit applies; free accounts on one IP address share one monthly allowance, and `used` counts it so. `minute` {limit}; `hour` {limit, used}, counted per API key. The counts trail by up to about a minute. Free: 0 credits, never counted toward the month. Same data as GET /v1/account/usage.
name: account_usage
title: Account Usage
